clips.title: The story
paras: Deep in Razorfen Kraul, Overlord Ramtusk leads the quilboar warriors into battle. He cries out for victory and for Agamaggan, and his fall breaks the Kraul defenders' martial strength.

Overlord Ramtusk commands the quilboar stronghold deep in Razorfen Kraul, in the southern Barrens. He enters battle with a cry to Agamaggan, the boar demigod, and rules the Kraul's fighters with unyielding authority.

Ramtusk directs the quilboar warriors through the Kraul's winding brambles. He keeps tight discipline among the bristled fighters who defend their tribe's sanctum. Elite marksmen flank him as he fights on the front line, bellowing rallying shouts and unleashing slams that can break opposing battle lines in seconds.
